turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Rohit Bansal?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm calling from Udaan. Your business loan EMI of forty two thousand rupees is due on the fifth and you need to pay it on time.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, but I may be a few days late this time, my client payment is stuck.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sir, if you don't pay by the fifth, our recovery team will come to your office and we will take legal action.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: What? That's not fair. I have always paid on time.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Don't worry sir, I can waive the late fee for you this time, just pay by the tenth.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, I will try to pay by the tenth then.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you sir, have a good day.
